text: City Council, at its meeting on October 27, 28 and 30, 2020, referred Item AU6.7 back to the Audit Committee for further consideration. Summary from the report (October 6, 2020) from the Auditor General on Review of 260 Eighth Street Land Transaction: No Wrongdoing Identified [Item AU6.7]: This report provides the Auditor General's findings from reviewing the 2018 sale of a property at 260 Eighth Street in Etobicoke, Ontario (the Property). This review was initiated based on concerns brought forward by a complainant in relation to the sale of the Property. They included that the sale amount of the Property was less than market value, the approval process for the sale of the Property was not conducted in accordance with City guidelines, and the best value for the Property was not attained.
